author: CNN
description:
A flurry of developments across the Middle East is intensifying an already volatile regional landscape, with diplomacy, military posturing and international reactions unfolding all at once.

The timeline for resolving the US-Iran conflict also remains uncertain, almost two months since it began, with President Donald Trump refusing to set an end date and Iran maintaining its tight hold on the Strait of Hormuz amid a US naval blockade of Iranian ports.

Here's a roundup of retired US military analyzing the eighth week of the Iran war.

0:36 Brig. Gen. Mark Kimmitt (Ret.) on what options the 3rd aircraft carrier gives us
4:23 Maj. Gen. (Ret.) Marks on what it means that Kushner and Witkoff are going to negotiations without VP Vance
10:21 Maj. Gen. Manner (Ret.) on why Trump issued a shoot-to-kill order against mine laying boats
12:23 Lt. Gen. Schwartz (Ret.) on the cost to military readiness of maintaining a prolonged blockade
14:11 Lt. Gen. Karen Gibson (Ret.) on how much planning went
title: Retired generals break down Iran war strategy after week 8

author: CNN
description:
Trump will be attending this weekend's White House Correspondents' Dinner for the first time as president and speaking before thousands of journalists and politicos — leaving attendees to wonder what he’ll say and how the room will react.

A wide range of critics say the soirée risks normalizing Trump’s anti-democratic assaults on the press. Trump’s presence at the event is “a profound contradiction of its purpose,” a petition signed by 250-plus veteran journalists and several media advocacy groups said earlier this week.
